Early treatments for COVID-19

Home
@CovidAnalysis
Submit
Updates
11,189 treatments have been reported as potentially beneficial for COVID-19. We currently analyze 6,432 studies for 215 treatments.
c19early.org
COVID-19 Clinical Evidence SummaryCOVID-19 Clinical Evidence
Analysis of 215 treatments and 6,400+ studies
  • Naso/oropharyngeal treatment Effective Treatment directly to the primary source of initial infection.
  • Healthy lifestyles Protective Exercise, sunlight, a healthy diet, and good sleep all reduce risk.
  • Immune support Effective Vitamins A, C, D, and zinc show reduced risk, as with other viruses.
  • Thermotherapy Effective Methods for increasing internal body temperature, enhancing immune system function.
  • Systemic agents Effective Many systemic agents reduce risk, and may be required when infection progresses.
  • High-profit systemic agents Conditional Effective, but with greater access and cost barriers.
  • Monoclonal antibodies Limited Utility Effective but rarely used—high cost, variant dependence, IV/SC admin.
  • Acetaminophen Harmful Increased risk of severe outcomes and mortality.
  • Remdesivir Harmful Increased mortality with longer followup. Increased kidney and liver injury, cardiac disorders.
We currently review studies for 215 treatments:
